name: AI Video and Image by AIRP
original_description:
Create AI images, logos and videos, including ad and product videos, through a short guided chat. The plugin asks a few questions, one at a time, turns your answers into a detailed brief, and gives you a link that opens your project on ManyMotions (manymotions.com) with those details filled in.
What you can create:
• Images, logos and general videos, such as YouTube, educational, personal or storytelling videos
• Ad, promo and product videos, such as UGC ads, product demos, testimonials, tutorials, product reviews and unboxing videos, tailored to your product, target audience, language and tone
Who it is for: content creators, marketers and small business owners who want images and short videos for social media, YouTube or product promotion without writing detailed prompts.
Limitations: the plugin does not generate images or videos inside ChatGPT. The final media is created on ManyMotions, a separate third-party service that requires a ManyMotions account. Ad and product videos are available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Mandarin and Indonesian.
